method: OPEN AND QUOTED, from the 'Mumps' chapter of the Australian Immunisation Handbook, retrieved 2026-09-23. Every pass claim is machine re-checkable. LICENCE: Free to read but NOT openly licensed -- health.gov.au states 'all other rights are reserved'. Quoted with attribution on the same footing as the Stroke Foundation, Kidney Health Australia and NHFA/CSANZ sources already in this compendium.

claims.claim: **All children 12 months and over: 2 doses — MMR at 12 months, MMRV at 18 months.** NIP-funded.
claims.source_text: All children aged ≥12 months are recommended to receive 2 doses of mumps-containing vaccine. … 12 months of age - MMR 18 months of age - MMRV Mumps-containing vaccine is funded through the NIP for children aged ≥12 months.
claims.locator: Australian Government Department of Health, Disability and Ageing, 'Mumps', The Australian Immunisation Handbook, at https://immunisationhandbook.health.gov.au/contents/vaccine-preventable-diseases/mumps, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: ⚠️ **Maximum infectiousness is from 2 days before illness onset to 5 days after.**
claims.source_text: Maximum infectiousness is between 2 days before onset of illness and 5 days afterwards.
claims.locator: Australian Government Department of Health, Disability and Ageing, 'Mumps', The Australian Immunisation Handbook, at https://immunisationhandbook.health.gov.au/contents/vaccine-preventable-diseases/mumps, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: ⚠️ **One-third of infections are asymptomatic.** Symptomatic disease ranges from **mild upper respiratory symptoms to widespread systemic involvement**.
claims.source_text: Asymptomatic infection occurs in one-third of cases. … Symptomatic disease ranges from mild upper respiratory symptoms to widespread systemic involvement.
claims.locator: Australian Government Department of Health, Disability and Ageing, 'Mumps', The Australian Immunisation Handbook, at https://immunisationhandbook.health.gov.au/contents/vaccine-preventable-diseases/mumps, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: ⚠️ **Mumps vaccine does not protect people if given after exposure.**
claims.source_text: Mumps-containing vaccine does not protect people if they receive it after they have been exposed to mumps.
claims.locator: Australian Government Department of Health, Disability and Ageing, 'Mumps', The Australian Immunisation Handbook, at https://immunisationhandbook.health.gov.au/contents/vaccine-preventable-diseases/mumps, retrieved 2026-09-23
